tools.label: Figma Make
tools.focus: Visual design systems and component generation
promptDirectives: Specify components, variants, hierarchy, and states clearly.
Describe layout behavior, spacing, and responsiveness.
Call out design system integration and accessibility expectations.

tools.label: Windsurf Builder
promptDirectives: Describe semantic structure, interaction states, and responsive behavior.
Emphasize accessibility, performance, and implementation clarity.
Ask for production-ready patterns rather than conceptual sketches.

tools.label: ChatGPT/Claude
promptDirectives: Ask for structured reasoning tied to the selected principles.
Emphasize rationale, user impact, and validation steps.

tools.label: Linear/Notion
promptDirectives: Translate the UX issue into a structured implementation brief.
Make goals, requirements, and anti-patterns explicit for teams.
Ask for acceptance criteria and rollout guidance.
